summary: Tunguz calls himself adjacent to accelerationists, says some pacing may be justified and worries that the benefits of AI are going to a few people.

statements.quote: I think we are all to some extent accelerationists. The question is just how far.
I do think that some cap might be necessary at some point and some pacing might be justifiable.
A few people, primarily in tech, are reaping enormous windfalls, while for the vast majority of the population AI seems extremely nebulous, at best.
They are using their workers to train their AI and replace them. Utterly cringe and dystopian.
NIMBYism will destroy America's march towards AGI.
